newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner up after upbeat Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner up after upbeat Q3 results.

text.p: Shares in Germany's Dresdner Bank made gains on Thursday after the bank said its operating profits advanced by nearly a third in the first nine months of the year.
The bank's operating profit rose 29.7 percent to 1.89 billion marks ($1.2 billion), in the range of analysts' expectations.
Dresdner shares touched a high of 41.30 marks in pre-bourse electronic dealings, but then fell back a little to trade up 53 pfennigs, or 1.3 percent, at 41.22 marks.
The DAX as a whole was up 7.89 points, or 0.3 percent, at 2,672.61 in IBIS dealings.
Dresdner also said it would post full year operating profit rise of more than 10-15 percent.
